source.citation: International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam (2014). Revised Release on Surface Tension of Ordinary Water Substance, IAPWS R1-76(2014). Moscow, Russia, June 2014.

transcription.from: the release (PDF from iapws.org, 6 pages), Table 1, p. 4, read on the page image
transcription.note: Transcribed for the test of water_surface_tension, whose equation and constants (p. 3) are in src/thermodynamics/water_properties.jl because they define it. Only the rows from the triple point to 100 C are transcribed; the table goes on to 370 C.

surface_tension.location: Table 1, p. 4: recommended values (column 2), their uncertainty (column 3), and the values of the interpolating equation (column 4)

notes: t_C is the Celsius temperature of column 1, ITS-90; the first row is the triple point, 0.01 C.
